replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal this infraction for two reasons. First off, triggerbot is not what's shown in this video, it behaves differently. Secondly, the evidence is inconclusive because of the fact that it's only two fights shown in first player. This makes it hard to tell whether you were actually hacking or not. I am giving you the benefit of the doubt.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
